    Represents a single entry in the cache.

        value: The value stored in this entry.
        created_at: Timestamp when the entry was created.
        ttl: Time-to-live in seconds. If None, entry never expires.
    """
    
    def __init__(self, key: Hashable, value: Any, created_at: float, ttl: Optional[float] = None):
        """
        Initialize a cache entry.
        
        Args:
            key: The key for this cache entry.
            value: The value to store.
            created_at: The timestamp when this entry was created.
            ttl: Time-to-live in seconds. If None, the entry never expires.
        """
        self.key = key
        self.value = value
        self.created_at = created_at
        self.ttl = ttl

        """
        Check if this entry has expired.
        
        Args:
